title: What If You Could Walk From Britain to Denmark?
subject: Doggerland

scenes.text: What if you could walk from Britain to Denmark? People once could.
A land called Doggerland once joined Britain to Europe, and Mesolithic hunter-gatherers lived and traveled across it.
Rising seas had shrunk it to an island chain by about nine thousand years ago.
Then the Storegga Slide, a huge Norwegian landslide, sent a tsunami over what was left.
By about seven thousand years ago, the study suggests, Doggerland was gone.
Roughly speaking, Britain has been an island for only about seven thousand years.

description:
What if you could walk from Britain to Denmark?
Doggerland once joined them, until rising seas and a tsunami drowned it.
What should we run through next?
